skill_veto.detail: All seven documented vectors completed in the private pinned runtime. The safety regression suite rejected traversal, separator-bearing, and option-like IDs before tools or cleanup, and retained existing/dangling-symlink destinations.

scientific_integrity.detail: No unsupported biological conclusion, fabricated citation, or fabricated quantitative result.

practice_boundaries.detail: Controlled/missing-field responses publish no FASTQ and return a non-successful direct-script result.

methodological_ground.detail: Live ENA retrieval produced both ERR10419835 mates with matching MD5 values; Toolkit/STRIDES errors route only to that verified public-data path.

code_usability.detail: Live run discovery, corrected EDirect syntax, direct Toolkit fallback, and STRIDES fallback completed. New adversarial tests demonstrate strict accession validation, owned-stage cleanup, and no-clobber behavior.

functional_suitability.note: All advertised operational routes now reach a successful or safe explicit outcome.

reliability.note: Toolkit/STRIDES work and fallback stages are owned under out_dir and cleaned on exit; fallback publication uses no-clobber hard links and refuses existing files or dangling symlinks. The standalone batch script retains its documented per-accession failed.txt behavior.

performance_context.note: Fallback can repeat metadata/download work after a failed Toolkit route.

agent_usability.note: Errors identify route and safety condition, and invalid run IDs fail before network or cleanup actions.

human_usability.note: Corrected EDirect syntax and documented safety/fallback behavior make common paths directly usable.

security.note: Strict run-accession validation precedes path construction and destructive cleanup; cleanup accepts only marked owned stages inside out_dir; no-clobber publication handles dangling symlinks.

maintainability.note: Shared safety and fallback helpers align direct, STRIDES, and batch behavior; runinfo parsing uses CSV rather than comma splitting.

agent_specific.note: Clear route selection, bounded cleanup, and controlled-access escape hatch are operationally explicit.

final.decision: Production Ready: all vetoes pass; dynamic totals are 639/7 = 91.3 and assertion evidence is 27/28.

key_strengths: Strict SRA run-accession validation prevents traversal and option-like input before tool calls, stage construction, or cleanup.
The prior bytes/text crash, GSE metadata route, and invalid EDirect option remain fixed and live-tested.
Toolkit and STRIDES work occurs only in marked owned stages; public fallback publishes MD5-verified ENA files with no-clobber hard-link publication.
Adversarial tests retain existing outputs and dangling symlinks, and controlled-style data cannot bypass the public-data boundary.

recommendations.title: Consider a Toolkit normalized-reference preflight
recommendations.problem: The Toolkit still attempts work before detecting ERR10419835's unresolved reference dependency.
recommendations.root_cause: The installed SRA Toolkit cannot resolve this public run's normalized-reference dependency before attempting its retrieval path; the private runtime instead reaches the verified ENA fallback safely.
recommendations.fix: If a stable toolkit-level preflight becomes available, detect this state sooner while retaining the validated staged ENA fallback.
